turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty busy! I had an important client pitch this afternoon, so I swapped my usual casual sweater for a sharp, tailored structured jacket and some formal pressed trousers.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks, I think it went really well. To stay focused beforehand, I put on some of those classic syncopated brass and piano vinyl albums from my grandfather's collection. There's nothing like old-school improvisation to get you in a creative flow.

turns.text: That sounds incredibly relaxing. Having that physical connection to your grandfather's collection must make the listening experience even better. Do you and Leah have any plans for the evening?

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that sounds absolutely mouthwatering! A spicy, warming dish is the perfect antidote to a cold Minneapolis night. Have you two made it often since the class?

turns.speaker: user
